thread:
mike: Heads-up — I have a small rollback/fix for an embeddings regression. Need a micro-cutover in the 03:00-03:15 UTC change window. Can we fast-approve?

mike: Cause: kvcache eviction race causing ~4-6% failed embeddings under burst. Fix = v2.3.1-hotfix (single-file patch + quant tweak). Staging smoke passed.

olivia: On it. PM + release notes ✅. Mike, paste the short release note text and pin command so I can approve.

alex: I'm the SRE oncall — will watch metrics. What's the exact pin command & rollback criteria?

mike: Pin command: `/deploy pin model-embed:v2.3.1-hotfix`. Need to skip canary because the regression can hide in canary parity. Rollback if embed_error_rate > 2% for 5m OR p95 latency increases by >200ms.

deploybot: Deploybot: deploy slot available at 03:05 UTC. To proceed run: `/deploy pin model-embed:v2.3.1-hotfix --force --no-canary`. Confirmers required: @olivia @alex (sre_oncall).

jess: I can handle release notes + changelog. Paste a 1-line blurb and I'll cut announcement.

jess: "Fix: kvcache eviction race causing failed embeddings under load. Hotfix v2.3.1 deployed; rollback if embed error rate >2% or latency regression."

olivia: :thumbsup: Approving expedited deploy for the 03:05 slot. @alex please take emergency monitor.

alex: Watching. I'll trigger rollback if thresholds hit. Doing a quick preflight check now: `curl -X POST https://internal.canary/check -d '{"model":"embed","version":"v2.3.1-hotfix"}'`

mike: Ok starting deploy at 03:05. Operator: @deploybot please proceed. Attaching intended command & note.

deploybot: Started deploy at 03:05 UTC. Rolling out 10% -> 50% -> 100% in 3 steps. Monitoring hooks (embed_error_rate, p95_latency) engaged. Deploy page: https://deploys.internal/1765432189

releasebot: Release note published to changelog: "2026-03-23 — v2.3.1-hotfix: Fix kvcache eviction race affecting embedding failures; performance parity restored."

alex: First 10% smoke looks clean. No error spike. p95 latency baseline 120ms -> 130ms (acceptable).

mike: 50% rollout complete, no errors observed in logs or alerts.

alex: 100% rollout done. Post-deploy aggregate (10m): embed_error_rate = 0.6%, p95 latency = 125ms. No rollback needed. :white_check_mark:

olivia: Published customer-facing note and internal release digest in #customers + docs. Thanks team — closing the loop.

mike: Thanks everyone, reassigning follow-up to postmortem if any anomalies show up.
